Eligibility of Tenderer : 1.The tenderer must have at least 5 years experience (in place of existing).
2. The tenderer must have the track record of honoring a single similar tender (Govt./Non-Govt.Organizations ) of min Taka 8 Lac
in last two (02) years.
3. The tenderer/bidder submit Valid VAT Registration Certificate, Valid Trade License. the Bank solvency certificate, Return
certificate of the financial year 2024-25.
4. Tenderer must have a working center/office/branch office in Chattogram City.
5. In order to prove the Tenderer Financial capability necessary to perform the contract, the Tenderer shall furnish the average
annual turnover at least 15(fifteen) Lac over the last Three (03) years.
6. The minimum amount of liquid assets or working capital or credit facilities of the Tenderer shall be Tk. 10 Lac.
7. All supply should be as per define catalog and Supplier must have to submit product sample and take approval before delivery.
